# A serialized two-face model generated with makeModel/writeModel; strip time-dependent metadata.
python3 -c 'import base64,sys;sys.stdout.buffer.write(base64.b64decode(""))' | spsplot  | sed -e '/^%%CreationDate/d' -e '/^%%Creator/d'
python3 -c 'import base64,sys;sys.stdout.buffer.write(base64.b64decode(""))' | spsplot style=normal gridx=dash gridz=dot gedge=0.2 gtri=0.7 axeswidth=2 ticwidth=1 gridwidth=0.5 | sed -e '/^%%CreationDate/d' -e '/^%%Creator/d'
python3 -c 'import base64,sys;sys.stdout.buffer.write(base64.b64decode(""))' | spsplot gmin=0.1 gmax=0.8 sgmin=1 sgmax=3 labelx=Distance labelz=Depth title=Example labelfont=Courier titlefont=Times-Bold labelsize=14 titlesize=20 titlecolor=red axescolor=blue gridcolor=green xbox=1 ybox=2 wbox=4 hbox=5 xbeg=0.2 xend=0.8 zbeg=0.1 zend=0.9 dxnum=0.2 fxnum=0.2 nxtic=2 dznum=0.2 fznum=0.2 nztic=3 gridx=solid gridz=solid | sed -e '/^%%CreationDate/d' -e '/^%%Creator/d'
python3 -c 'import base64,sys;sys.stdout.buffer.write(base64.b64decode(""))' | spsplot gedge=-1 gtri=2 sgmin=1 sgmax=1 verbose=1 | sed -e '/^%%CreationDate/d' -e '/^%%Creator/d'
python3 -c 'import base64,sys;sys.stdout.buffer.write(base64.b64decode(""))' | spsplot style=unknown gridx=dot gridz=dash gmin=1 gmax=0 | sed -e '/^%%CreationDate/d' -e '/^%%Creator/d'
printf '\001\000\000\000' | spsplot
printf '\377\000\000\000' | spsplot
python3 -c 'import base64,sys;sys.stdout.buffer.write(base64.b64decode(""))' | spsplot nxtic=999999999999999999999
spsplot </dev/null
